fact: The New Times reports that under the MoU signed 17 February 2026 between the Government of Rwanda and Anthropic, Anthropic will provide Claude access, training programmes, technical support and capacity-building initiatives for public servants, and that under the earlier Chidi initiative Rwanda set a target of training up to 2,000 teachers and civil servants in applying AI.
